title: Zesty Nutty Middle Eastern Labneh
description: A satvik-friendly Middle Eastern dish featuring labneh, bacon lardon, and nuts, perfect for a lazy Sunday morning. This recipe is a twist on traditional labneh with a nutty and zesty flavor.
instructions: Preheat the broiler to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together the sumac, salt, and black pepper.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the pomegranate molasses and lemon juice.
In a large bowl, combine the labneh cheese, chopped walnuts, and sumac mixture.
Stir in the pomegranate molasses mixture until well combined.
Cook the diced bacon lardon in a pan over medium heat until crispy.
Remove the bacon from the pan and set aside on a paper towel-lined plate.
Broil the labneh mixture for 5 minutes, or until it is lightly browned and set.
Top the labneh with the crispy bacon lardon and chopped parsley.
Serve the zesty nutty Middle Eastern labneh hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
